claim.en: SNS sought her removal from the parliamentary committee overseeing Military Intelligence, alleging property ties to organised-crime figures that she concealed when nominated; Krištúfková said she never hid anything.
claim.sk: SNS navrhla odvolať ju z výboru na kontrolu Vojenského spravodajstva s tvrdením, že má majetkové prepojenia s postavami podsvetia, ktoré pri nominácii zatajila; Krištúfková uviedla, že nikdy nič netajila.

findings.quote: Strana predloží na predmetnej schôdzi dôkaz prepojenia poslankyne s mafiou, najmä majetkové prepojenia. Uvedené informácie pani poslankyňa Petra Krištúfková pri svojej nominácii utajila,“ zdôrazňuje SNS.…„SNS je v tom namočená až po uši. V mojom prípade nejde o nič nové, u nich však ide o nové kauzy. Ja som nikdy nič netajila,“ dodala Krištúfková.
findings.title: SNS chce Krištúfkovú odvolať z výboru na kontrolu činnosti Vojenského spravodajstva

claim.en: In 2008 Krištúfková was on trial for fraud, accused of selling a building of Róbert Dinič's former company Espada without telling his other heirs; she said mafia boss Peter Havaši forced her to sign the papers.
claim.sk: Krištúfková bola v roku 2008 súdená za podvod, lebo podľa obžaloby predala budovu Diničovej bývalej firmy Espada bez vedomia ďalších dedičov; tvrdila, že papiere ju prinútil podpísať mafián Peter Havaši.

findings.identity: Petra Krištúfková, mother of Róbert Dinič's child and then girlfriend of Boris Kollár (the Sme rodina leader)
findings.quote: Krištúfková faces up to 12 years in jail if convicted of selling a building that belonged to one of Dinič’s former companies, Espada, without telling the other inheritors of his estate.…Krištúfková, meanwhile, claimed that after Róbert Dinič’s death she was forced to move out of the apartment they had shared, and that she was forced to sign off on the ownership papers to the Sk23 million building on Kollárovo námestie in downtown Bratislava by a subsequent boyfriend, Peter Havaši
findings.title: Dinič brothers terrorized Bratislava businessmen
